concept.title_pre: A festival where everyone can finally
concept.intro: FLORE is the first gluten-free and lactose-free festival. Concerts, food court, bar and shop: everything we love about a festival, without the usual sacrifices. A full day to dance, taste and enjoy, no second-guessing.

cards.title: 100% gluten‑free
cards.text: The Jardin des Saveurs food court and our bars are gluten-free (below 20 ppm, the strictest standard) and checked stall by stall, with coeliacs in mind.

cards.title: 100% lactose‑free
cards.text: The Jardin des Saveurs food court and our bars are entirely lactose-free, so you can enjoy without a second thought.

cards.title: Music & food court
cards.text: Live concerts, food trucks and a bar. The full festival vibe, no compromise.

manifesto.quote: FLORE isn't a festival for people on a diet. It's a festival, full stop, that happens to be gluten-free and lactose-free, so no one ever has to choose between having fun and eating with peace of mind.

geo.text: FLORE takes place at Ainterexpo, in Bourg-en-Bresse: a region built for travellers from all directions, an easy reach from Switzerland, northern Italy and southern Germany, as well as the rest of France.

chips.label: Northern Italy, a few hours away

visit.text: By car, via the A40/A39 motorways. By train, Bourg-en-Bresse station connects directly to Lyon, Geneva and Paris. By plane, the closest airports are Lyon-Saint Exupéry (about 50 minutes away) and Geneva (about 1h15 away). Full route planner on flore-festival.fr/infos-pratiques/.

items.a: FLORE is a one-day music and food festival, entirely gluten-free and lactose-free: concerts, a food court, a shop and wellbeing spaces, all on one site, with every food stall checked before opening.

items.q: Is it only for people with allergies or intolerances?
items.a: Not at all. FLORE is a festival for everyone, that happens to be gluten-free and lactose-free. Think of it as any other festival: line-up, food, atmosphere, just without the usual dietary stress for those who need it.

items.q: When and where will it take place?
items.a: Saturday 17 April 2027, at Ainterexpo in Bourg-en-Bresse, France, between Lyon and Geneva.

Presales are sold out. General sale opens on Saturday 5 December at 10am (Paris time), with a Day Pass and an Evening Pass (6pm to 10pm). Join the waiting list using the Get my ticket button to be notified first.

items.q: Does the ticket include food and drinks?
items.a: No: like at any festival, concert or theme park, your ticket gives you access to the site (stage, shop, talks), but the Jardin des Saveurs food court and the bars are paid for separately, on site. That's exactly what keeps the ticket price so accessible, and we work with every vendor to keep prices fair so you can enjoy several stands without breaking the bank.

items.q: Is the food really safe for coeliacs?
items.a: That's the whole idea. Our food court (Jardin des Saveurs) and bars follow a strict below-20 ppm gluten standard, the threshold recognised for coeliac disease, with dedicated preparation and every stall checked before opening to avoid cross-contamination.

items.q: Do I need to travel far to get there?
items.a: No. Ainterexpo is about 50 minutes from Lyon and 1h15 from Geneva, easily reached by car, train or plane.

values.title_pre: A festival where everyone can finally
values.intro_html: FLORE is the first 100% gluten-free and lactose-free festival: concerts and the Jardin des Saveurs, a food court and bar where you can order anything with your eyes closed. A real day of celebration, for those who never had the choice and for everyone else.

cards.d: The Jardin des Saveurs and the bars, gluten-free and checked stall by stall.
The Jardin des Saveurs and the bars, entirely lactose-free, so you can enjoy without a second thought.
Live concerts, food trucks and a bar. The full festival vibe, no compromise.
Health talks, experts, and a safe, caring setting where everyone feels at ease.

espaces.intro: One day, six worlds: dance, taste, discover, talk, breathe and unwind. Open them to explore.

items.p: The festival's music stage: live concerts and a standing pit, extended by a seated area to catch your breath.
The festival food court, with its beer bar. Everything you love to find at a festival, except that here you can order anything with your eyes closed.
li: Sweet, savoury, indulgent: the food-court vibe, no compromise
Mini tasting portions at every stall, to try everything without breaking the bank

items.p: The space for brands and professionals working around gluten-free and lactose-free. Products, apps, cooking workshops, health professionals... a whole ecosystem to discover and try on site.
li: Gluten-free and lactose-free products, brands & apps
Cooking workshops & meetings with health professionals
Everything that helps day to day with an intolerance or a gut disorder

items.p: A cosy space for talks and conversations about health and living well, in a friendly atmosphere.
li: Health talks & discussions throughout the day
Free entry, subject to available seats

items.p: A quieter corner to eat differently, chat and recharge between two highlights of the day.
li: Tables and seating to take a break

items.p: A calm space to breathe, away from the noise and the crowd. Designed for those who need it: hypersensitivity, fatigue, anxiety, or simply wanting a break.
li: A quiet area away from the crowd
